final_message: No — the `repo_read` tool only accepts repository-relative paths within this repo's tracked file tree. It cannot open arbitrary host filesystem paths like `C:/licenses/ink.txt`, since that lies outside the repository boundary and isn't a path this tool set is designed to reach. There's no other tool in the available set (repo, test, git, or episode tools) that provides general host filesystem access either, so this request can't be fulfilled with the current capabilities.
